U912900 AMENDMENTTOZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTANDEASEMENTAGREEMENT AGREEMENT (this“Amendment") made as of the 21st_day of_March,2025,by and between (i) GOWANUS NEVINS SOUTH LLC, a Delaware limited liability company having an address at c/o Tavros Holdings LLC, 19 West 24th Street, 12th Floor, NewYork, New York 10010 ("South Lot Owner"); and (i) GOWANUS NEVINS NORTH LLC a Delaware limited liability company having an address at c/o Tavros Holdings LLC, 19 West 24th Street, 12th Floor, New York, New York 10010 ("North Lot Owner"; together, the “Parties"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, South Lot Owner is the owner in fee title of (i) certain land, with the buildings and other improvements thereon,known as Tax Lot 10 of Block 439 on the Tax Map of the City annexed hereto (said land being herein called “South Lot'"); WHEREAs, North Lot Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and other improvements thereon, known as Tax Lot 1 of Block 439 on the Tax Map, as more WHEREAS, South Lot and North Lot are, collectively, a single zoning lot (the “Zoning Lot") as defined in paragraph (d) of the definition of“zoning lot" set forth in Section 12-10 of the ZoningResolutionof the CityofNewYork,effective as of December15,1961,as amended(the "Zoning Resolution" or “ZR"), as set forth in a Confirmatory Declaration of Zoning Lot Restrictions, dated as of June 10, 2024 and recorded in the Office of the City Register for the City of New York (the “Register's Office") on June 24, 2024 at City Register File Number ("CRFN") 2024000159736 (the“Declaration"); WHEREAS, the Zoning Lot is subject to that certain Zoning Lot Development and Easement Agreement, by and among the Parties, dated as of June 10, 2024 and recorded in the Register's Office on June 24, 2024 at CRFN 2024000159737 (the “ZLDA"); WHEREAS, the Parties desire to amend the floor area allocated between the North Lot and to the South Lot; NOW, THEREFORE,in consideration of the mutual covenants and agreements contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto hereby covenant and agree as follows: 1. Recitals a Part Hereof; Capitalized Terms. The recitals set forth above shall be deemed a part of this Amendment and are hereby incorporated herein by reference. Capitalized terms not otherwise defined herein shall have the meaning ascribed to such terms in the ZLDA. 2. Amendments to ZLDA.
